title: Performance calculation
current_gap: The owned model boundary has normalized actuator inputs and some archived RPM-labelled output slots, but no accepted current, voltage, battery, power, energy or FlyEval formula/service contract.

atoms.name: hover_time_endurance
atoms.required: Sourced battery/load/usable-energy contract and stop semantics

atoms.name: motor_current
atoms.required: Per-motor/total current source, units and calibration

atoms.name: rotor_speed
atoms.required: Independent four-motor RPM mapping and timing evidence

atoms.name: input_power
atoms.required: Voltage/current source or explicitly sourced electrical model

atoms.name: efficiency
atoms.required: Frozen useful-output and energy formula with denominator rules

atoms.name: flyeval_reference_flow
atoms.required: Separate local/service formula, availability and comparison contract

missing_value_rule: required channels are unavailable, never silently zero
formula_policy: no formula approved until source, units, sampling boundary and version are frozen

followups.blocked_by: Electrical/propulsion source and units are not accepted

files: runtime files reserved after model/battery review

preserved.hardware_and_service: no hardware action and no external service call
